name: Special Work Permit

requirements.blocker_text: The employer, not the worker, applies for the special permit to the Citizenship and Migration Department, naming the specific foreign worker.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a job offer from a Belarusian employer willing to sponsor the permit.

requirements.blocker_text: Employer must post the vacancy in the Republican Vacancy Bank and with the district employment department for at least 15 working days before applying for the permit, to show no suitable Belarusian citizen or permanently-residing foreigner was available.

requirement_groups.name: Exempt from labour market test -- highly qualified workers

requirements.blocker_text: Exempt from the labour-market-test requirement if the worker has 5+ years of relevant professional experience and a salary exceeding 15 times the minimum monthly salary rate; is a citizen of an EAEU member state (Russia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Armenia); or is a head of a representative office or commercial organisation they founded/own.

evidence_required.document: Employer's vacancy-posting records (Republican Vacancy Bank, 15+ working days)

outcome.duration_length: 2 years for highly qualified workers; 1 year for others; renewable once, then requires a new application

sources.title: Embassy of the Republic of Belarus in Finland (mfa.gov.by) -- Employment of a Foreigner in the Republic of Belarus: employer-sponsored special permit, 15-working-day vacancy posting, highly-qualified-worker exemptions, 1yr/2yr permit durations, processing timelines
